verdicts.reason: A: the praying-hands photo has shrunk to a black sliver that is almost entirely covered by the white text panel, so the key image is lost. The cloud shapes are left as faint white-on-white outlines floating in the empty left half, and a stray plus sign sits on the photo edge next to the text. The quote and its attribution do stay together and readable. B is worse: the photo is reduced to a meaningless black rectangle cut off at the top edge, and the clouds and plus signs are gone. The attribution 'MAHATMA GANDHI' is pulled far right, away from its quote, and the bottom half of the canvas is dead white space. Nothing of the original's feel survives in B.
